caption:
There is no "ADHD Executive Function Mode" in Claude. 🚫

But the prompts in that reel actually work:
1. Break a task into steps under 1 minute, give me only the first
2. Act as my body double and check in every 10 minutes
3. Turn this boring task into a quest with a reward

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.

#adhd #productivity #claudeai #aitips
